name: Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods
source:
[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] takes place on the chilly snow planet of Trion XY7N, where a prestigious museum is hosting new artifact exhibits from around Universe 3-6-07.

Orlando and his crew are looking for their next gig, and the museum is a prime target with their priceless relics on display. Not to mention this mysterious "Amulet of the Gods" with unknown godlike power is sitting there, waiting to be stolen.

Can this crew of misfits outwit Riggs and Luca, the local law enforcement, and steal the Amulet of the Gods?

[From [url=https://snowhavenstudios.itch.io/slippery-flippers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]Slippery Flippers：第一集 - 众神的护身符[/i] 发生在Trion XY7N寒冷的雪星球上，那里的一家著名博物馆正在举办来自3-6-07宇宙的新文物展览。

奥兰多和他的团队正在寻找下一场演出，而博物馆是主要目标，展出了他们无价的文物。更何况这枚有着未知神力的神秘“诸神护身符”正坐在那里，等待着被盗走。

这群不合群的人能智胜当地执法人员里格斯和卢卡，偷走众神的护身符吗？

[来自[url=https://snowhavenstudios.itch.io/slippery-flippers]itch.io[/url]]
